lines.speaker: Sable 2  (voice: sable2)
lines.old: Quiet out here. I don't like it. It never means nothing.
lines.new: Quiet out here. I don't like it.

lines.speaker: Sable 2  (voice: sable2)
lines.old: Lector's coming out of the ice. Everybody dark. Get up and pull your breaker, Sable 1. Now.
lines.new: Lector's coming out of the ice. Everybody go dark. Get up and pull your breaker, Sable 1. Now.

lines.speaker: Lector  (voice: earth_lector)
lines.old: Biologics in the dark. We will find you. We always have.
lines.new: Hiding in the dark. We will find you.

lines.speaker: Lector  (voice: earth_lector)
lines.old: Biologic. Sable one. I see you. All of you.
lines.new: I see you. All of you.

lines.speaker: Warden  (voice: earth_warden)
lines.old: Biologics. You were us, once.
lines.new: We were once like you. We have ascended.

lines.speaker: Warden  (voice: earth_warden)
lines.old: The fallen return to be unmade.
lines.new: You return to us, and you will be ascended.

lines.speaker: Warden  (voice: earth_warden)
lines.old: Kneel, remnant. Or burn where you are.
lines.new: Disable your shields, and prepare for your ascension.

lines.speaker: Warden  (voice: earth_warden)
lines.old: Your blood remembers Earth. Earth does not remember you.
lines.new: You remember Earth. Earth does not remember you.

lines.speaker: Warden  (voice: earth_warden)
lines.old: The dark between the stars was ours before you crawled into it.
lines.new: You have no place here anymore.

lines.speaker: Warden  (voice: earth_warden)
lines.old: This is the last of your kind's courage. Spend it.
lines.new: This will all be over soon.

lines.speaker: Small Mercy  (voice: mercy)
lines.old: Warden's beams are quiet. Ours are free. Thank you.
lines.new: Warden's beam weapon is down!!!

lines.speaker: Tamsin  (voice: tamsin)
lines.old: Tamsin to escort. Drive's cooked and the aft holds are open to space. We make the jump point if nobody shoots at us. Somebody will.
lines.new: Tamsin to escort. Drive's cooked and the aft holds are open to space. We can make the to jump point if we go undetected.

lines.speaker: Lector  (voice: earth_lector, earth_warden)
lines.old: A vessel of the fallen, crawling home. How touching.
lines.new: What are these things that resist?

lines.speaker: Lector  (voice: earth_lector, earth_warden)
lines.old: Every remnant ends. Yours ends here.
lines.new: Those we leave behind will remain in eternal darkness. Ascend with us now. It is your only hope.

lines.speaker: Lector  (voice: earth_lector, earth_warden)
lines.old: You brought them to us. That was a kindness.
lines.new: We only wish to release you from your suffering. Disable your shields now to embrace your ascension.

lines.speaker: Lector  (voice: earth_lector, earth_warden)
lines.old: The door you run for is a grave. Go on.
lines.new: Fighting only prolongs your suffering.

lines.speaker: Lector  (voice: earth_lector)
lines.old: Lector. You carry four hundred biologics. We will count them as they freeze.
lines.new: We can sense four hundred and fifty two of you on that vessel. Join us now and free yourself from suffering.

lines.speaker: Sable 2  (voice: sable2)
lines.old: Lector's sweeping for life signs. If you had a breaker to pull, now would be the time.
lines.new: Lector's sweeping for life signs. Power down now or it'll see you!

lines.speaker: Lector  (voice: earth_lector)
lines.old: Censers, go. Bring me the ark.
lines.new: Bring them to me.

lines.speaker: Tamsin  (voice: tamsin)
lines.old: Bombers on the scope. They're coming for us. Please don't let them.
lines.new: Bombers on the scope. They're coming for us, help us for God's sake!!!

lines.speaker: Lantern 1  (voice: lantern)
lines.old: Lantern flight, jumping in. Sorry we're late. Traffic.
lines.new: Lantern flight, jumping in. Sorry we're late. Hope we didn't miss much.

lines.speaker: Tamsin  (voice: tamsin)
lines.old: Your wingman's gone. We saw it. Sorry.
lines.new: Your wingman's gone!

lines.speaker: <any wingman>  (voice: sable1, sable2, sable3)
lines.old: Lector's breaking up. Shame.
lines.new: Oh my God, the Lector is breaking up!!! Look at it!!!

lines.speaker: Lector  (voice: earth_lector, earth_warden)
lines.old: More of us than there are of you. There always will be.
lines.new: Our congress grows - join it, and leave your prison.

lines.speaker: #Tamsin  (voice: tamsin)
lines.old: We're through. Drinks are on us. Somebody else is paying.
lines.new: We're through. Thank you Sable. First round's on us.

lines.speaker: sable2, sable3
lines.old: Disabling. It can sit there and think about it.
lines.new: Disabling - just let it sit there.

lines.speaker: earth_lector, earth_warden
lines.old: Biologics. You were us, once.
lines.new: We were once like you. We have ascended.

lines.speaker: earth_lector, earth_warden
lines.old: Kneel, remnant. Or burn where you are.
lines.new: Disable your shields, and prepare for your ascension.

lines.speaker: earth_lector, earth_warden
lines.old: Your blood remembers Earth. Earth does not remember you.
lines.new: You remember Earth. Earth does not remember you.

lines.speaker: earth_lector, earth_warden
lines.old: Your ark is a coffin. We will close it.
lines.new: You have chosen your own destruction. Do not hate us for what we do.
